description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys IPC CreateKeySession functionality in the Rialto project. It includes test cases for success, failure, disconnection, reconnection, and error scenarios, as well as helper functions and a test fixture class.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysIpcCreateKeySessionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the CreateKeySession IPC functionality, derived from MediaKeysIpcTestBase. It sets up the test environment and provides helper methods for simulating responses.

methods.name: setCreateKeySessionResponseFailed
methods.description: Sets a failed response for CreateKeySession, simulating an error returned from the IPC.
